property_summary: For every call to setL1BlockValues(...) the contract's public getter hash() is set to the provided _hash; the mutant omits assigning hash, so for some inputs (any _hash different from prior value) hash() will differ from the provided _hash and thus violate the rule.
change_summary: Remove the assignment to `hash` (delete the statement), leaving previous value unchanged which changes observed hash after call when input _hash differed.
